transaction_log_contract.acks: Exact issued operation, request/phase sequence and syscall observation are required once; stale/duplicated/cross-session/unsolicited ACK refuses permanently.
transaction_log_contract.compaction: No committed history/state may disappear before full source/readback and atomic new-root publication; original WAL/store remains retained until migration qualifies.
transaction_log_contract.durability: Visible effect, durable commit and returned ACK are separate facts. Lost/failed commit ACK is never automatically retried as a fresh transaction. Reopen/recovery reads actual committed bytes before deciding replay.
transaction_log_contract.format_status: Physical log/index format is not frozen by this value-transport ABI; a complete persisted format and independent crash proof are required before activation.
transaction_log_contract.journal_boundary: Reserve/inline SQL-equivalent mutation ACK remains before enclosing transaction COMMIT, preserving the retained journal oracle.
transaction_log_contract.multiwriter: Native engine must arbitrate the same complete namespace across processes. A host-provided row or unverified boolean lock claim is not arbitration.
transaction_log_contract.read_scope: Non-authoritative slot inspection must not become adoption authority. Atomic adopt/rollback includes effect and completed response.
transaction_log_contract.recovery: Incomplete uncommitted tails cannot become completed state. Corrupt committed history must not be silently truncated. Recovery cannot clear unknown request/budget owners or discard active leases.

value_representation.SQL_affinity: The exact original statement and declared schema remain the oracle for binding/affinity and storage-class comparison. Native binding/affinity belongs to HIA, never a Python sqlite3 conversion helper. Raw migration imports already observed storage classes separately from ordinary bindings.
value_representation.envelope: little-endian u64 tag; little-endian u64 payload_bytes; exact unpadded payload
value_representation.integer_scope: Arbitrary-precision clocks stay decimal TEXT. Machine INTEGER limits apply only where the original SQLite INTEGER field imposed them. Generation/epoch canonical u64 admission remains its existing owner.
value_representation.sequence: costs AUTOINCREMENT high-water must survive migration and recovery, including values absent from any surviving row.

tags.1: signed INTEGER, exact little-endian 64-bit two-complement payload
tags.2: REAL, exact little-endian IEEE binary64 storage bits
tags.3: TEXT, exact persisted byte extent; no normalization and no narrowing of decimal strings

value_representation.text_boundary: Ordinary Python strings are UTF-8 foreign observations. Persisted TEXT bytes are preserved; decoding/diagnostics are not silently canonicalized during migration.
value_representation.total_size: u64 transport/file extent, checked before arithmetic; no added aggregate store/row count or byte limit

commands.1: BEGIN, body empty, chunk_sequence 0, next request serial
commands.2: FEED, exact body extent, next chunk sequence
commands.3: FINISH, body empty, next chunk sequence, all envelopes complete

value_stream_kernel.custody_limit: This stream validator does not authenticate an externally supplied log or source and does not itself issue store references. The full HIA coordinator must bind actual same-call immutable input, source offsets and borrowed result leases.
value_stream_kernel.operations: 1..31 exact relational bind arity/table; 100 raw persisted row with exact table width; 101 generic value stream, table 0. 100/101 are private engine channels, never public request authority.
value_stream_kernel.poison: Any protocol refusal permanently refuses that workspace. A too-short workspace cannot hold poison; the caller must discard the whole lease.
